title: Extend sim_core.pyx coverage
details: Расширить sim_core.pyx для покрытия sensory_phase, combat_phase, social_phase. Ускорение в 2-5× на этих фазах. sim_core.pyx.
notes: P12 complete: Extended sim_core.pyx with get_neighbors + cy_sense_food. Rebuilt .pyd (killed python.exe first). Key changes: (1) sim_core.pyx: added libc imports, _PI2 constant, get_neighbors(grid,x,y,radius) Cython fn, cy_sense_food() bulk food ray sampling; (2) main.py: removed dead simulate_step import (was blocking _HAVE_SIM_CORE=True), added optional cy_sense_food import (_HAVE_CY_FOOD_SENSE), integrated cy_sense_food before sensory_phase, changed grid=None to grid_wrapper.grid in Cython path (sensory_phase + post_step), moved grid_wrapper.refresh() before if/else; (3) cell.py: sensory_phase(skip_food_ray=False) param. Results: ALL three Cython flags now True (_HAVE_SIM_CORE, _HAVE_CY_FOOD_SENSE, spatial._HAVE_CY — all were False before). Benchmark: 20.6x speedup on food ray sampling (0.107 vs 2.196ms/200cells). 8s sim no errors. Tests: syntax, imports, get_neighbors correctness, cy_sense_food unit vectors + food-direction correctness all pass.
